reply.text:
That one needs a doctor, not a coach. Chest pressure with exertion that started this week is something to get checked promptly, and I can't assess it or tell you what it is. Please get in touch with a doctor soon, and if it comes on strongly or doesn't ease when you stop, treat it as urgent and call emergency services.

Until you've been seen and cleared, I'd hold off on hard training. Once you have the all-clear, I'm glad to build the training around whatever they tell you.
